summary: It proposes a namespace, machine-readable descriptors, and a service-provider interface so engines can handle new blob types without compile-time knowledge, enabling incremental adoption without format changes. Vote in progress: 1 binding +1, 1 non-binding +1 The meeting will discuss adopting Iceberg v4 in the Go client, prioritizing which features to implement first, and planning the transition to a stable 1.0 release. Attendees will review remaining breaking changes, set a target tag, and identify any overlapping work that must be resolved before the 1.0 cut. The thread asks whether Iceberg V4 should cease writing new ORC and Avro files because these formats lack support for recent V4 features such as variant shredding and vector types.
